comparison.objective: Clamp locking pliers onto a tube past their over-center lock point and verify the lock by release.
comparison.physical_skill: One-gripper force application, jaw positioning, over-center mechanism actuation, and release verification.
comparison.success_condition: Pliers remain locked on the tube after the gripper lets go without unacceptable tube displacement or damage.
comparison.reason: Over-center latching under force is a different tested mechanism from orientation-dependent granular flow. No material rubric detail is missing.
